items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 11:1
items.html: The light of Haya at every level whatsoever is discerned as the phase of the self and the essence, without which there is no recognition at all in the level. Therefore even the phase of the fetus has no recognition until three months have passed over it, for only at the completion of the three months, when the filling of the 46 sparks of HaVaYaH of AB, which is the phase of the Haya of the fetus, enters into it, does it have its own phase of self, and it has recognition outwardly. (Item 21).
